name: GazzIT Simple Popup Everywhere
author: GazzIT

sections.description:
GazzIT Simple Popup Everywhere is a powerful yet lightweight WordPress plugin designed for creating stunning, high-converting popups. Whether you prefer the simplicity of the native WordPress block editor or the robust drag-and-drop experience of Elementor, this plugin gives you the ultimate flexibility to build the perfect modal for any purpose.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Dual Editor Support: Seamlessly create and manage your popups using either the Standard WordPress Block Editor or Elementor.
  • Elementor Integration: Utilize Elementor’s intuitive interface, premium widgets, and advanced styling options to craft visually rich popup designs.
  • Native Gutenberg Power: Leverage the core WordPress experience for fast, clean, and lightweight popups using familiar blocks.
  • Conversion-Focused Triggers: Control how your popups appear to maximize impact using page load triggers, widgets, or shortcodes.

Who is this Plugin for?

  • Agencies & Developers: Offer clients the flexibility of using either Elementor or native WordPress blocks, catering to any workflow preference.
  • Bloggers & Publishers: Grow your email list and highlight important articles without slowing down your website.
  • E-commerce Stores: Announce flash sales, offer discount codes, and collect email addresses to reduce cart abandonment.

Install GazzIT Simple Popup Everywhere today and turn your visitors into loyal customers!
sections.installation:
1. Standard WordPress Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New.
  3. In the search bar, type GazzIT Simple Popup Everywhere.
  4. Find the plugin in the search results and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click Activate.
  6. You will find the new menu item in your WordPress Dashboard sidebar.

2. Manual Installation (Via Upload)

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New.
  4. Click the Upload Plugin button at the top of the screen.
  5. Click Choose File, select the downloaded .zip file, and click Install Now.
  6. Once the upload is complete, click Activate Plugin.
